answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 5792 Country: India Title: batcha paida hone ke baad kitne dinom me katna(yani sunthi) karna chayiye? Question: batcha paida hone ke baad kitne dinom me katna(yani sunthi) karna chayiye? Answer ID: 5792 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 367/367=M/1429) The scholars of Fiqh have written that it is mustahab (desirable) to circumcise a child from seven to twelve year of his age. However, circumcision is allowed before this as well: وفی الفتاوی الھندیۃ: ابتداء الوقت المستحب للختان من سبع سنين الی اثني عشر سنة هو المختار ( 5/357 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
